title: FAQ: Is my data safe?
caption:
"Is my data safe?" It should be your first question.

In Stacko, each company's data is kept separate from every other company's, and access follows the roles you set. Every change keeps who, what, when and where, with before and after values, and a correction is a new entry, never an edit.

More security questions? Ask below, or book a meeting and a person from our team will answer. Link in bio.
